json_ld.description:
The GO Sport ANC True Wireless Earbuds are sport ear-hook earbuds built for workouts and commutes, with active noise canceling, Be Aware mode, and an IP55 rating. They come in 4 colorways.
Active Noise Canceling blocks out gym or commute noise to help you stay focused, while Be Aware mode lets outside sound through on demand for safety during outdoor runs, without pausing playback. Wind Noise Reduction, available in the JLab App, filters out wind noise on the move.
Soft, bendable ear hooks combined with 3 sets of gel ear tips (small, medium, large) lock the earbuds in place through movement, reducing slipping during workouts.
An IP55 rating protects against sweat, splash, and dust, so the earbuds hold up through rain, sweat, or heavy effort.
10mm dynamic drivers with neodymium magnets deliver a 20Hz to 20kHz frequency response, with built-in Lab Spatial Audio EQ for a fuller soundstage. Output is rated at 104dB ± 3dB.
Two MEMS microphones with noise canceling pick up voice clearly during calls, cutting through gym or traffic noise. 
Bluetooth 6 connects with a 30+ foot range, and Bluetooth Multipoint pairs two devices at once, letting the earbuds switch from a laptop to a phone without re-pairing. Google Fast Pair speeds up setup on Android, and Microsoft Swift Pair does the same on Windows.
The JLab App adds custom EQ, touch control customization, ANC and Be Aware toggling, Spatial Audio, Wind Noise Reduction, and a built-in workout timer.
Each earbud lasts 8.5+ hours per charge, with the charging case extending total playtime to 35+ hours, or 24+ hours with ANC on. The case charges via USB-C in 2 hours, and a 10 minute rapid charge adds 1 hour of playtime.
Includes: GO Sport ANC earbuds, a charging case, 3 sets of gel tips (small, medium, large), and a JLab 2 year limited warranty.
